title: Smoothness at generic points of geometrically reduced fibres
statement: Let $p:Z\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphism of Noetherian schemes (quasi-compact schemes locally the spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]). Suppose all geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are reduced, meaning their local rings have no nonzero nilpotents. If $s\in S$ and $z\in Z_s=Z\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is the generic point of an irreducible component of that fibre [def-weil-irreducible-components, def-sc-generic-point], then $p$ is smooth at the image of $z$ in $Z$: that point has an open neighbourhood $W$ for which $p|_W$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

source.place: Tag 056V, lemma-geometrically-reduced-dense-smooth-open, together with Morphisms Tag 01V9, lemma-smooth-at-point, equivalence (1)⇔(2), in literature/stacks-project/morphisms.tex. This is the smoothness input in Temkin Proposition 3.5.2, printed p. 21.

proof.text: The hypothesis hred s directly supplies GeometricallyReduced for the residue-field fibre morphism. Local finite presentation is preserved by base change (the Mathlib instance). Apply [lem-pur-geometrically-reduced-dense-smooth-open] to obtain density of its smooth locus D; D is open by the definition Scheme.Hom.smoothLocus.
The equality closure {z} = C and hC show z belongs to genericPoints of the fibre. Apply [lem-sbc-flat-fibre-dimension-strata-cover] with the entire base open, t=s and W=D, obtaining z in D.

Apply the already proved source-library pointwise fibre criterion [lem-trf-flat-fibre-smooth-locus-image] to obtain p.fiberι s z in p.smoothLocus. Choose W=p.smoothLocus. Mathlib Scheme.Hom.preimage_smoothLocus_eq identifies the smooth locus of W.ι ≫ p with the preimage of W under its own inclusion, which is top. Scheme.Hom.smoothLocus_eq_top_iff therefore proves Smooth (W.ι ≫ p).

lean.statement: theorem generic_fibre_points_smooth {Z S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian S] (p : Z ⟶ S) [Flat p] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p] (hred : ∀ s : S, GeometricallyReduced (p.fiberToSpecResidueField s)) (s : S) (C : Set (p.fiber s)) (hC : C ∈ irreducibleComponents (p.fiber s)) (z : p.fiber s) (hz : IsGenericPoint z C) : ∃ W : Z.Opens, p.fiberι s z ∈ W ∧ Smooth (W.ι ≫ p)
